## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] Tests cover the change
- [ ] A schema change comes with its migration (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] New or changed UI text has its German translation
- [ ] No customer data, machine numbers or secrets in the diff
